Release checklist

What must be resolved

  • Active service and exact protocol
  • Performing provider and publishable qualifications
  • Indications, candidacy, contraindications, limitations, and recovery
  • Diagnosis/referral and physician-coordination language
  • Clinically reviewed care instructions with owner and review date
  • Authentic approved media with consent, alt intent, and responsive crops
  • Named practice, clinical, compliance, and asset approvers
